description: A PRICING PROBE, NOT A MODELLING RUN - it is citable for its CLOCK and its HEAP and for nothing else, and no share, count, boarding or fit from it may be quoted, compared or fitted. f35_pricing_probe_25pct re-taken on family F36's demand and controler. Two things changed under the previous price and both sit inside the mobsim, which is three quarters of an iteration: (a) the Java fold of 9.210 - the taxi fleet scales by the sample, one routing pool serves the run, a timed-out ride request no longer returns a zero-second leg, the retime counters and the held-ride gate are new event-time work - so the committed controler is cbc97779cea8827a where the newest priced arm 20260916T063903_250it_25pct executed 3a547df08516c556; (b) the roots rebuild of 9.211 - 276,816 held ride trips on 141,633 persons whose whole day is held now seed ONE plan each rather than a choice set, bike carries a marginal utility of distance for the first time, the household tail is redrawn and transit standing room is scaled with the seats - so both the replanning work per iteration and the population itself differ from the run the 25.1 h quote rests on. arm_cost.py itself refuses to call that quote a price for this stack (9.153: an arm once ran 45 % over a price read from a stack differing by one line). WHAT IT MEASURES: the recurring iteration's wall clock and the live heap after a full collection at 25 % on THIS build and THIS demand, so that F36's arm 0 is quoted on a number taken from itself rather than an inherited one. Four iterations at 25 % reads nothing else: the choice set does not close until about iteration 27 (9.163), and at four iterations every mode deviation is a transient. Settings are the arm's own - 48g, GC log on, create_graphs off - because a price taken on different settings prices a different run.

justification.RUN.controler.last_iteration: The declared sweep starts at 250 because that is the largest value MEASURED to be insufficient for convergence (DECISIONS.md 9.7), so the whole range describes candidate MODELLING runs. This is not one. Four iterations is this repository's established pricing horizon at 25 % (20260909T011135_4it_25pct, 9.160; f33_pricing_probe_25pct, f34_pricing_probe_25pct, f35_pricing_probe_25pct): it is the shortest depth at which the recurring iteration - replanning, a re-routed plan executed and scored, a router reading the previous iteration's travel times - has actually run, which is the only iteration whose clock predicts an arm's. The value sits two orders below the range so any output carrying it is obviously not a result.
justification.RUN.gate.interval_iterations: The mode gate is switched OFF because this probe has no modes to judge: at four iterations every deviation it could compute is a transient the board may not read, and stopping on one would report a pricing question as a modelling failure. The COST watcher stays armed in its place at 2.0 h - the horizon F35's probe declared, kept because the F35 probe recurred at 467.5 s an iteration and four of those plus setup is well under it, while the fold's new in-mobsim work is the unknown this probe exists to bound - so the run is not left with no automatic stop of either kind, which src/run/run_matsim.py refuses before the JVM starts (9.163, #169). The ceiling is not a budget; it is the tripwire for a stack that has become dramatically slower, which is what this probe exists to find out.
